STAGE 2: Main Application & Placement Schedule (Current Work)
Apply slurry bonding coat of 🔗 Sika® MonoTop®-610 SK-RP13 onto SSD concrete substrate. Place repair mortar wet-on-wet up to 50 mm thickness in single layer without slumping.

Compact firmly against cavity edges and rebar backs to prevent honeycombs. Finish with wood or synthetic float.

repair.appSchedule:
SYSTEM: Structural Concrete Restoration & Anti-Carbonation Protection System

STAGE 1: Substrate Preparation & Priming (Before Work)
Sawcut repair perimeter to 10 mm depth to prevent feather edges. Chip out spalled concrete. Sandblast or wire brush rebar to Sa 2.5 and apply 🔗 Sika® MonoTop®-610 SK-RP13 anti-corrosion slurry.

STAGE 2: Main Application & Placement Schedule (Current Work)
Apply slurry bonding coat of 🔗 Sika® MonoTop®-610 SK-RP13 onto SSD concrete substrate. Place repair mortar wet-on-wet up to 50 mm thickness in single layer without slumping.

STAGE 3: Detailing, Reinforcement & Joint Treatment
Compact firmly against cavity edges and rebar backs to prevent honeycombs. Finish with wood or synthetic float.

STAGE 4: Finishing, Curing & Topcoat Protection (After Work / Until Finish)
Wet cure under polythene sheets or apply curing compound for 3 days. Topcoat with protective 🔗 Sikagard®-62 SK-PR22 barrier against chloride and carbonation ingress.

repair.subtitle: Bonding Primer & Reinforcement Anti-Corrosion Protection Slurry
repair.desc: Sika® MonoTop®-610 is a 1-component, polymer-modified cementitious slurry containing silica fume, used as an anti-corrosion barrier on rebar and a bonding primer on concrete.
repair.highlight: Rebar Anti-Corrosion & Bonding Primer • Active Corrosion Inhibitors
repair.yieldCoverage: As rebar coating: ~2 kg/m² (~1.5 to 2.0 kg/m² as bonding slurry)
repair.potLifeCure: Pot life: ~1.5 to 2.0 hours at 20°C | Recoat: wet-on-wet with repair mortar

techData.chemicalBase: Polymer-modified cementitious slurry with active corrosion inhibitors and silica fume
techData.compressiveStrength: Compressive strength: ~50 MPa at 28 days | Bond strength: >2.0 MPa
techData.coverage: Rebar protection: ~2.0 kg/m² per coat (2 coats required, ~2 mm total DFT)
techData.applicationMethod: Stiff paintbrush or textured hopper gun
techData.thinning: Clean water only: ~5.0 – 5.5 Liters per 25 kg bag
techData.cleanUp: Clean water while material is fresh
techData.packaging: 25 kg bag
